scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.
actual_writer_findings: perf body writes request number and all six args before do_syscall; offload helper writes rtid/ttid and response req_thread_status/pde_data; send helper writes request.valid and response.status
getcred existing request is whole-zeroed in predecessor, then number,args0,args1 written; selected host getcred maps physical scratch and writes eight current IDs in order
mcexec credential bridge ignores ioctl result; act_setfsuid replies zero on this branch, so source alone cannot establish valid initialized output on failure
response completion and memory mapping/visibility/lifetime remain real runtime proof obligations; no ACK, zero-fill or new error policy proposed
